checkedOccurrences.textualBasisJa: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.

The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.

wikipediaActualRead.title: Ein Rogel
wikipediaActualRead.identityBasisJa: 記事はEn-rogel/Ein Rogelをエルサレム近郊の泉として説明し、Joshua 15:7と18:16の境界地点と明記。Bir Ayoub同定は最も一般的とする一方、反対説・Gihon Spring説も記す。
wikipediaActualRead.actualPageExcerptJa: 記事のHebrew Bible節はJosh 15:7・18:16を境界標識として説明し、Bir Ayoub同定に異論を挙げる。

geographyAssessmentJa: 都市ではなく泉の候補としてのみ表示し「境界泉・比定に議論」と注記する。Bir Ayoub/シルワンやGihon Springへの同定を確定扱いせず、候補点は未確認とする。
